text: The Secondary Signal Dial (GluD Receptors): While NMDA receptors are the main door calcium comes in through when glutamate fires, another door was recently discovered in the GluD receptors. What opens them is D-serine (one of the tools below) and GABA, the neurotransmitter that usually quiets down communication, not glutamate (Wang, et al, 2025).
reader: someone with trauma or in withdrawal who is anxious, wired or raging, deciding which of the protocol's tools to take and how to run their therapy sessions

checked.point: NMDA receptor opening is "the main spark that starts up neuronal excitation", and GluD is "another calcium door"
checked.found: AMPA receptors start the excitation; magnesium holds NMDA receptors shut until that depolarization frees them, and they are then the main calcium door (Hansen 2018). The GluD2 channel passes very little calcium (Schmid 2009)
checked.still_needed: yes: they learn GluD is a second door at the same synapse, opened by D-serine and GABA
